description: Shell script providing compatibility wrappers for /sbin/uci, including functions for loading, setting, reverting, and managing UCI configurations in OpenWrt.

methods.name: uci_load
methods.description: Loads UCI configuration for a specified package, exporting relevant variables.

methods.name: uci_set_default
methods.description: Sets default configuration for a package if not already set.

methods.name: uci_revert_state
methods.description: Reverts UCI configuration state to a previous saved state.

methods.name: uci_set_state
methods.description: Sets a specific UCI configuration state value.

methods.name: uci_toggle_state
methods.description: Reverts and then sets a UCI configuration state.

methods.name: uci_add_list
methods.description: Adds a value to a UCI list option.

methods.name: uci_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI configuration value from a specific state directory.

methods.name: uci_get
methods.description: Gets a UCI configuration value, with optional default.

methods.name: uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new UCI configuration section or sets a section type.

methods.name: uci_remove
methods.description: Removes a UCI configuration section or option.

methods.name: uci_remove_list
methods.description: Removes a value from a UCI list.

methods.name: uci_revert
methods.description: Reverts a UCI configuration to a previous state.
